name: trodoai/skills
description: Trodo skill swarm — orchestrator + install masters (events, agent tracing) + a tracing heal/audit master. Each master loads modules inline for its sub-areas (identify, groups, custom events, sessions for events; vercel-ai, otel, langchain, openai, mcp for tracing). trodo-heal-tracing audits an existing tracing integration, finds the gaps that make the dashboard lie (false 'ok' on failures, error-with-no-message, missing spans, empty output, anon users, wrong run shape), proposes a fix per gap, and applies on approval. Further heal/developer skills slot in as additional top-level entries following the same 6-phase contract.

future_bundles.heal: Reserved for further developer/healing skills (trodo-heal-*). Same 6-phase skill contract; orchestrated by trodo-install in diagnose mode. trodo-heal-tracing (the tracing audit/heal master) has shipped; trodo-heal-server-global-events and others slot in here next.
